SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT IVDT.BUYER,IVDT.INV_NO,IVDT.INV_SEQ,IVHD.INV_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE IVDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND IVDT.BUYER = 'KRSUNG0341' AND IVDT.BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO= IVHD.INV_NO AND IVHD.INV_TYPE = '0' AND trim(IVHD.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) is not null UNION SELECT BUYER,INV_NO,INV_SEQ,PROCESS_TYPE FROM WMSIVDT WHERE SND_CHK = 'N' AND BUYER = 'KRSUNG0341' AND trim(LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) is not null
